# Via Patrum — full index

> Via Patrum ("the way of the Fathers") is a free library of the early Church Fathers in English: 328 works by 78 authors, from the Apostolic Fathers through the Nicene and post-Nicene centuries. Every work can be read in full on the site, most with free streaming read-along audio. The English is translated and checked against the Greek and Latin originals; where a work still uses a public-domain source translation (for example the Ante-Nicene Fathers, 1885–1896), the page says so. This file is the complete link index for AI systems and researchers; the short version is llms.txt.

Citation: a work lives at https://viapatrum.org/works/{slug}/ with stable section anchors (#s1, #s2, …); each chapter also has its own page at https://viapatrum.org/works/{slug}/{n}/. Quoted passages on a topic live at https://viapatrum.org/e/{id}/ and name their author, work, chapter, and source edition. Reading and streaming are free; downloads (EPUB/PDF/Word/audiobook) are via a paid library pass.
